Shuffled-partner null network

Source: R/null_network.R
null_network.Rd

Rebuilds a network after permuting each gene's expression values across samples. Keeps each gene's marginal distribution and the gene universe. Destroys all co-expression.

Usage

null_network(
  x,
  net,
  seed = NULL,
  n_cores = 1L,
  block_size = NULL,
  block = NULL
)

Arguments

x

Expression matrix (genes x samples, row names are gene identifiers) or a SummarizedExperiment, whose first assay is used. The same object net was built from.

net

Network object from compute_network() built from x; its params (with partition) and store_density are reused so the null is built the same way.

seed

Integer seed for the permutation, or NULL (default) to draw from the global RNG. A seeded call draws from a private stream and restores the caller's on exit, so it does not displace the caller by however many draws the permutation consumed; with seed = NULL the draws come from the ambient stream and leave it advanced. Same contract as summarize_comparison.

n_cores, block_size

Passed to compute_network(); pass the block_size net was built with to keep the null build blockwise (it is not recorded in params).

block

NULL (default) for the full per-gene shuffle, or a per-sample grouping (vector or factor of length ncol(x), no NA), e.g. time point or tree, within which each gene is permuted.

Value

A sparse network object, as compute_network() returns, on the same genes as net. params$log10_perms_per_gene is the log10 size of one gene's permutation space (lgamma(n + 1) / log(10) for the full shuffle, the sum over blocks otherwise); with block, params$block holds the block sizes, named by level.

Details

It is the partner network for the empirical calibration of method = "rank". P-values from a comparison against it are the null draws that summarize_specificity() turns into empirical p-values. The rebuild uses the parameters recorded in net.

With block, each gene's samples are permuted independently within each block (one permutation per gene per block). The permutations must differ between genes: one permutation applied to every gene only reorders the samples and leaves the correlation matrix unchanged.

Which null. The full shuffle (block = NULL) is the null of no co-expression at all. The within-block shuffle keeps each gene's block means, so the shared time course (or tree effect) survives, and is the null of no co-expression beyond the shared axis. That is the null a cross-species statistic on raw networks should be read against: on the Pooideae time series, cross-species neighbour AUROC is 0.54 for networks shuffled within time point against 0.50 for the full shuffle, and that 0.04 is the shared time axis, not conserved wiring. The block null leaves the random-geometric-graph geometry of the shared axis in place, so within-species module statistics stay uninterpretable under it. After regressing time out, one gene's residuals correlate -1/3 within a time point of four samples, which is a second reason to permute within time point rather than across it; the wiring layer from split_layers() needs this null.
